w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Chorus Line mauled Sari (-30 health) over 4 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Callback is here.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Ad Break. It's here.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Ellis telling Caleb about Cormac. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
Ellis came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
